The robot followed the corridor through its corners to the red wall, stopped in front of it, and I called `rest`. It is now crouched with motors off.

The final sonar readings were 0.67 m on the left and 0.25 m on the right. The right reading is from the wall edge at a slight angle, so the robot is about 0.5–0.7 m from the wall, roughly square to it.

Two stops were caused by collision protection (near corners), so I worked around them by turning and re-approaching. The route had several turns: a left, a right, a left, another right, then a final left toward the red wall.
